text:
Ravi: Heads-up — final rehearsal for the Apr 14 webinar 'Practical Inference Economics' tomorrow 9:30am PT. Need a quick pass on order, failover owner, and a single benchmark slide.

Tessa: I made a short alternate run if a demo needs to be trimmed: move panel earlier, drop demo 2 to a lightning note. Want to keep Q&A 25m.

Hannah: Ack. Also request: add captions + transcript note in the pre-show checklist. We should have a fallback text-only demo in case streaming dies.

Phil: I can present the benchmark slide. Which metric do we want? 95th-latency + cost-per-1k tokens?

Ravi: Yes — 95th-latency and $/1k tokens for each model/quantization we demo. Phil please include a small table and 1-sentence callout.

OpsBot: Rehearsal scheduled: 2026-04-13 09:30 PT — Zoom: https://zoom.example/rehearsal. Pre-show webhook run at 09:15 (warm, health, fallback check).

Tessa: Proposed live run-of-show (short):
```
09:30 - Pre-roll / intro music (Ops)
09:33 - Host welcome + agenda (Ravi) - 5m
09:38 - Tech keynote: inference cost patterns (Tessa) - 10m
09:48 - Demo A: routing + cache (Phil) - 12m (warm 10m prior)
10:00 - Demo B: quantized performance & numbers (Hannah) - 8m
10:08 - Rapid panel: tradeoffs & ops checklist (Ravi, Tessa, Phil) - 20m
10:28 - Live Q&A (All) - 25m
10:53 - Close & CTA (Ravi) - 7m
```

Phil: I'll take Demo A. Note: need to run /warm-cache with two warm prompts: short prompt + long context. InfraOps can we schedule that?

InfraOps: Will add a pre-show job hitting /warm-cache with prompts: "short:", "long: <500 tokens sample>", then verify /v1/generate/prod and /v1/generate/quant-v2 via curl. Will also post status here.

Hannah: For Demo B, if model memory spikes, plan: switch to quant-v2 endpoint and display 'fallback slide' with numbers. Jin from infra used similar flow last month.

Ravi: Who's the on-stage ops contact? Phil volunteered?

Phil: I can be on-stage ops, monitor dashboards, and trigger fallback if needed. Hannah will call the fallback step in the demo script.

Tessa: Recording logistics: RecordingBot will auto-upload to #marketing-recordings. Also record local backup to handoff to comms.

RecordingBot: Recording enabled for rehearsal. Auto-upload path: gs://redwood-recordings/marketing/2026-04-13-rehearsal.mp4

Ravi: Two rehearsal failure scenarios to validate: 1) OOM on primary model -> quant fallback, 2) High latency from region -> reroute to us-east cluster. Phil/Hannah run these during dry run.

InfraOps: Endpoint names: primary: /v1/generate/prod, quant fallback: /v1/generate/quant-v2, region fallback host: us-east.infer.redwood. We'll attach a curl script to the drive.

Tessa: Can someone draft the quick curl script snippet for the panel to show? A tiny example is useful.

InfraOps: Pasting sample (will put full script in drive):
```
# simulate warm
for p in "short" "long"; do curl -X POST https://us-west.infer.redwood/warm-cache -d "{\"prompt\": \"$p\"}"; done
# health check
curl https://us-west.infer.redwood/v1/health
```

Hannah: Also request for comms: a 1-paragraph abstract and 1-sentence social caption to go live after webinar. I'll draft and drop to the folder.

Ravi: Good. Final asks before rehearsal: 1) deck v5 in drive by EOD today, 2) benchmark slide from Phil by 5pm, 3) panel bios + headshots in shared folder, 4) rehearsal recording notes uploaded within 24h.

Phil: Benchmark slide incoming by 4:30pm. I'll use latest perf run from Apr 8.

Tessa: I'll update the slide master for captions and add an 'if streaming fails' slide.

Ravi: Thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll lock this run-of-show at 5pm and send final calendar. :thumbsup:

Phil: No objections.

Hannah: All good.

InfraOps: Pre-show webhook configured. Will post a status ping 15m before rehearsal.

Ravi: Locking in — see you at rehearsal.
